effect_description_eng:
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When another Digimon with [Etemon] or [Sukamon] in its name is deleted, 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -3000 DP and ＜Security A. -1＞ (This Digimon checks 1 fewer security card.) until the end of your opponent's turn.
[Opponent's Turn] All of your Digimon with [Etemon] or [Sukamon] in their names gain ＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.), and can't be returned to the hand or deck.
